ground_truth: ENGIE’s 2025 sustainability report describes decarbonization levers including coal exit, renewables and storage, electricity networks, greening gas and green hydrogen; it reports 2024 achievements such as ~2 GW coal installed capacity, 51 GW renewable projects pipeline, 4.2 GW additional renewable capacity, and a coal phase-out commitment for 2025 in continental Europe and 2027 for the rest of the world. Schneider Electric’s 2024 sustainability report discloses AVEVA near-term targets to reduce absolute Scope 1 and 2 GHG emissions 90% by 2030 and absolute Scope 3 GHG emissions 50% by 2030 from a 2020 base year, plus long-term net-zero GHG emissions across the value chain by 2050.
